LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_BroadcastCooldown_Tooltip: Days to wait after one broadcast before another. 0 to 10 days, default 3.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_SuiyinTrust_Summary: Suiyin's trust reflects how you treat famine ratkin. While she is the storyteller, trust can affect raid probability at your colonies. Ordinary incidents and their long follow-ups remain available.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_SuiyinTrust_NoGame: Load a game to view current trust.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_SuiyinTrust_Compatibility17: 1.7 keeps this save's existing trust effects. By default, trust does not alter visitor attitudes or this mod's incident frequency, and entrusted-family and exchanged-child care do not award additional trust. Older saves that already enabled these effects keep them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TrustMissingDays_Tooltip: A visitor is considered missing after this many days with unknown whereabouts. Range 0 to 60 days, default 1 day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TrustObserveDays_Tooltip: The deadline for clarifying ordinary relief visitors' whereabouts, and the observation window for entrusted children to reach the child stage. Relief visitors who are still present can continue accumulating time alive. Range 0 to 120 days, default 30 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Broadcast_Tooltip: Colonists can broadcast from a comms console to call famine ratkin here. Normally one group responds; during famine years, broadcasts try to call more distinct groups, using the visitor multiplier rounded up. Incident settings, appearance limits and the cooldown below still apply. Disabling this option stops new broadcasts. Groups already traveling keep coming.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TrustRange_Tooltip: Amount added to or subtracted from Suiyin's trust in you when this happens. Range -100 to 100; at 0, trust stays unchanged.
